name: SisDeli
source:
Kenichi Tajima was an average "freeter" or freelance part-timer.
He lived on his own at the moment.
He had no girlfriend, so after work he spent all his time online.

Today he'd won a small lottery jackpot, good for casual shopping.

How should he spend the money? He scrolled through his bookmarks.
Ah, "SisDeli", an escort service that catered to guys like Kenichi. Guys with an elder sister complex.

Kenichi had always been fond of his real older sister.
He'd fantasized about her many times and from high school he masturbated into her soft, feminine panties.

SisDeli was a perfect choice. He'd always wanted to try this.

There were two courses: Standard and Special

He entered his "order" with nervous excitement.
Now to make the phone call. This was happening. Here we go.

目前，他獨自一人生活。
因為沒有女朋友，每天下班後，他都在上網打發時間。

今天，他中了一個小額獎項，獎金正好夠隨意買點東西。

該拿這筆錢做什麼？他翻看著瀏覽器的書籤。
啊，對了，「SisDeli」——一家專為健一這種男人提供伴遊服務的店。他們都是有姊姊情結的男人。

健一一直很迷戀自己的親姊姊。
他無數次以姊姊為對象展開幻想，從高中起便會對著她柔軟而充滿女性氣息的內褲自慰。

SisDeli正是完美選擇。他早就想體驗一次了。

這裡有兩種套餐：標準套餐與特別套餐。

他懷著緊張又興奮的心情填好了「訂單」。
接下來只要打電話。一切就要成真了。開始吧。
